I hand-checked each expected output by enumerating the short windows (and, where relevant, using full periods of `nums`) on the infinite array.

```json
[
  {"input": "[1]\n1", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "[1]\n3", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "[5]\n7", "output": "-1"},
  {"input": "[1, 2, 3]\n6", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "[1, 2, 3]\n12", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "[3, 1, 1]\n5", "output": "3"},
  {"input": "[10, 20, 30]\n50", "output": "2"},
  {"input": "[100000]\n1000000000", "output": "10000"},
  {"input": "[2, 1, 1, 1]\n7", "output": "6"},
  {"input": "[3, 5]\n8", "output": "2"}
]
```
